hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2; files=$({ git diff HEAD --name-only --diff-filter=d; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u); [ -z "$files" ] && exit 0; if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1; then rtk prek run -q --files $files; else prek run -q --files $files; fi >&2 || exit 2
